categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of civil water pumps. Main product categories include land pumps, small submersible pumps, deep well submersible pumps, circulation pumps, and energy-efficient pumps. These products are widely applied in agricultural irrigation, domestic water supply, deep well water extraction, livestock watering, and hot water circulation fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including asynchronous motor design, small water pump constant pressure control systems, submersible motor structure design, motor sensorless drive technology, high-precision shaft processing, vacuum impregnation, human-machine interactive variable frequency control, permanent magnet synchronous motor design, power factor correction, DC brushless motor vector control, power line carrier communication, intelligent controller development, and solar water pump systems. Production methods include automatic winding and embedding processes, CNC precision automatic machining, and automatic casting processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers across multiple regions and industries. Primary customer types include distributors and brand manufacturers in agricultural irrigation, domestic water supply, deep well extraction, livestock watering, and heating circulation sectors. Major markets include Asia, Americas, Europe, Africa, and Oceania, with significant presence in Bangladesh, United States, South Korea, Russia, and Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with major presence in Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, Africa, and Oceania regions. Key operating locations include mainland China (headquarters in Wenling, Taizhou, Zhejiang), United States, Russia, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Singapore. Domestic sales account for 17.24% of revenue while international sales represent 82.76%.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the water pump supply chain. It manufactures core components including stators, rotors, and pump bodies in-house, then assembles complete water pump products for distribution through a network of distributors and brand manufacturers to end-users in agricultural, domestic, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-efficiency, energy-saving, and environmentally-friendly water pump development. Strategic priorities include permanent magnet synchronous motor technology, intelligent control systems, solar-powered pump systems, and product standardization and modularization. R&D initiatives emphasize improving pump efficiency, reducing noise, enhancing durability, and developing smart monitoring capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of water pumps and related components. The business model is based on a buy-out distribution system where the company sells products to authorized distributors and brand manufacturers who handle downstream sales and after-sales service. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered and control transfers to customers, with payment typically made via letters of credit or cash.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major international competitors include Grundfos (Denmark), Wilo (Germany), Pedrollo (Italy), and Lowara (Germany). Domestic competitors include Leo Co., Ltd., Dayuan Pump, Junhe Co., Ltd., and Lingxiao Pump. According to the China General Machinery Industry Association Pump Branch, the company ranks fifth among Chinese water pump exporters in recent years.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 743.37 million yuan, representing 4.05% growth from 2023's 714.40 million yuan. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 12.65 million yuan in 2024, down 76.35% from 2023's 53.50 million yuan, primarily due to depreciation from new production capacity and convertible bond interest expenses. Total assets reached 1.73 billion yuan at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high efficiency, energy conservation, and environmental sustainability in its water pump products. Key differentiators include advanced permanent magnet synchronous motor technology for superior energy efficiency, intelligent control systems enabling real-time monitoring and optimization, solar-powered pump solutions for remote areas, and comprehensive product portfolio serving diverse applications. The company holds 141 patents and maintains ISO9001 certification plus multiple international product certifications (CSA, CE, TUV, etc.).
